d: Percy is a pair of puffy shorts or bloomers.

s.cutCuff.d: The **Cuffs** are two strips of fabric {{{ width }}} wide and {{{ length }}} long.
s.cutPocketFacing.t: The pocket facing is not shown
s.cutPocketFacing.d: The **Pocket Facing** (8) is not shown, but you can trace it from the Pocket (7) piece. Cut off the corner along the outline left from the green lining boundary, but remember your seam allowance.

o.cuffWidth.d: How wide to make the leg cuffs.
o.pocketDepth.d: How far below the waist the pockets should end. Measure from your waist to where your fingertips fall on your side.
o.pocketOpeningDepth.d: How deep the pocket openings should be. They can't be shallower than the necessary front opening.
o.frontPleat.d: Whether to generate a pleat on the front panel.
o.frontPleatPosition.d: Where to generate a pleat on the front panel.
o.frontPleatWidth.d: How big of a pleat to generate on the front panel.
o.frontPleatDisplayLength.d: How far to draw the pleat preview lines. This doesn't affect shaping at all.
o.inseamPercent.d: How long the inseam of the shorts should be. 100% = floor length, 40-50% = knee length.
o.frontPanelPercentage.d: What proportion of the front of the pants should be taken up by the front panel.
o.hemRatio.d: How far the bottom hem should be flared, relative to the same height on a basic Titan
o.slashIterations.d: How many cuts to make to spread the body panels. Turn this up if it looks jagged.
